description.zh: 应用名，若为EDAS应用，则AppName为EDAS中的App ID，可在EDAS控制台“应用管理>基本信息”中查看对应的ID。
description.en: The application name. If the application is an EDAS application, set AppName to the App ID in EDAS. You can view the corresponding ID on the **Application Management > Basic Information** page in the EDAS console.

description.zh: 流控效果。0表示快速失败，1表示预热启动，2表示排队等待。
description.en: The flow control effect. Valid values: 0: fast failure. 1: warm-up. 2: queuing.
Specifies whether to enable the rule. Default value: false.
The source application. Default value: default.

description.zh: 超时时间，单位毫秒。当controlBehavior值为2（排队等待）时，需要设置该字段。
description.en: The timeout period, in milliseconds. This parameter is required when ControlBehavior is set to 2 (queuing).

description.zh: 关联接口名、入口资源名。当统计维度relationStrategy值为1（关联接口）或2（链路入口）时，需要设置该字段。
description.en: The associated interface name or entrance resource name. This parameter is required when RelationStrategy is set to 1 (associated interface) or 2 (chain entrance).

description.zh: 统计维度。0表示当前接口，1表示关联接口，2表示链路入口。
description.en: The statistical dimension. Valid values: 0: current interface. 1: associated interface. 2: chain entrance.

description.zh: 资源名。不能超过1024个字符，且该资源名需要与接口详情页面的资源名称相对应。
description.en: The resource name. The value cannot exceed 1024 characters and must correspond to the resource name on the interface details page.

description.zh: 流控规则的阈值，取值范围为≥0的整数。
description.en: The threshold of the flow control rule. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to 0.
The threshold mode for flow control.

description.zh: 预热时间，单位秒。当controlBehavior值为1（预热启动）时，需要设置该字段。
description.en: The warm-up period, in seconds. This parameter is required when ControlBehavior is set to 1 (warm-up).
